frequency_question: How often does Indian annual CPI inflation exceed 5.0% in the post-monsoon release month following an El Niño agricultural disruption cycle?
membership_rule: Includes MoSPI headline CPI prints for September/October published between 2014 and 2024 that followed a recorded El Niño agricultural shock year. Excludes structural regime changes in inflation-targeting mandates prior to 2016.
coverage_note: 3 named; represents the complete set of comparable post-inflation-targeting framework weather shock cycles.
known_gaps: Excludes fiscal subsidy adjustments unique to specific election years.
skeleton: Observed post-shock agricultural CPI spikes across three distinct weather anomaly cycles in the past decade.
multiplier: 3 relevant cycles evaluated, 2 resulting in headline prints above 5.0%.
validity_reason: Agricultural vulnerability and Reserve Bank of India mandate structures remain stable through this horizon.
